card.text: F6 star in Puppis, 263 parsecs away, circled every 31 hours by a giant planet passing over its poles.

introduction.text: WASP-121 is an F-type star a little larger and hotter than the Sun. Its planet WASP-121b orbits so close that it circles in 31 hours.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.
